brand.name: Rotaleaf
brand.note: Now in public beta for kitchens of up to 30 staff
brand.summary: Rotaleaf lays out a week of shifts on one screen, totals everyone's hours as you go, and sends each person their shifts by text when you publish.
brand.tagline: Shift rotas for small kitchens, planned in minutes

faqs.a: Nothing. Before the beta ends we will publish pricing at least 30 days ahead of any charge, and you can export your rotas at any time.
faqs.q: What does it cost during the beta?

faqs.a: No. Rotaleaf plans shifts and totals hours. It exports a CSV that you can import into your payroll provider.
faqs.q: Does it replace our payroll system?

faqs.a: No. Shifts and swap confirmations arrive by text message, which works on any phone.

items.text: Drag shifts onto a week view and copy last week's pattern in one step.
items.title: One-screen week

items.text: Staff ask to swap from their phone. You approve or decline, and the rota updates for everyone.
items.title: Swap requests

items.text: Planned hours sit beside contracted hours for each person, so overtime shows before you publish.
items.title: Hours as you plan

items.text: Published shifts go out by text message. Nobody needs to install anything to see their week.
items.title: Text, not another app

items.text: Download approved hours as a CSV with one row per person per shift.
items.title: Payroll export

items.text: Plan on a tablet in the back office with no signal. Changes sync when you reconnect.
items.title: Works offline
